messages:
Anya V: spinning up Aurora-2B on dev-staging for initial bring-up. plan: fp16 baseline, int8 static quant, then quick smoke evals. anyone seeing conflicts with the queue?
Marc H: LGTM. leave one slot for canary. what's the target latency SLO for dev checks?
Anya V: nothing strict — aim <120ms p50 token on dev GPU, just sanity. this is mainly correctness + hallucination checks.
Sami (ML Eng): I'll run the quick prompt set and the safety/format tests. dropping prompts here:
```
1) Q: "Summarize in one sentence: The new apk crashes on launch"
2) Q: "Convert to JSON: name=Alice, age=29"
3) Q: "Explain why pi is irrational in 2-3 bullets"
```
Sami (ML Eng): Also plan to run `curl` smoke generator:
```
curl -sS -X POST https://dev.redwood/api/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $DEV_KEY' -d '{"model":"aurora-2b","input":"What is 2+2?","max_tokens":20}'
```
infra-bot: deploy-task queued: job_id=aurora2b-dev-1968001111
Luis (SRE): FYI I bumped up ephemeral quota for this run. watch GPU memory on quant.
Marc H: for int8, remind me — using static per-channel AFFINE quant + KV cache preserved?
Sami (ML Eng): yes static per-channel + calibrate on 2k tokens from dev dataset. keep KV in fp16.
Anya V: checklist for this thread:
- create dev config + model alias
- baseline fp16 run (latency/throughput)
- static int8 quant run + regression diff
- run 50 sanity prompts + parse-checks
- quick evals (squad-like + formatting)
- log failures to /evals/aurora2b/1968001111
Marc H: I'll take baseline and perf. Sami take quant and evals.
Sami (ML Eng): noted. starting quant cal now, ETA 25m.
Sami (ML Eng): quick note — tokenization mismatch on one prompt, see below:
```
input: "name=O'Connor"
model out: "name=O\'Connor"
```
Sami (ML Eng): likely escape handling in detokenizer across quant path; flagging.
Anya V: good catch. mark as blocker only if it affects many cases. add to regression board.
evals-bot: smoke-run complete: fp16 pass=48/50, int8 pass=44/50. diffs stored: s3://redwood-qa/aurora2b/1968001111/diffs.json
Marc H: 44/50 ok for dev, but check the two hallucination failures.
Sami (ML Eng): already looking. looks like one is number formatting, other is entity drop. pushing tiny prompt fix for formatting parity.
Anya V: thanks team. next steps: if int8 regressions <=5%, promote to canary. if >5%, create rollback + bug triage ticket.
Luis (SRE): I'll keep the slot till canary decision. ping me when ready to promote.
Marc H: leaving logs and perf traces in /tmp/aurora2b/1968001111
Anya V: closing out — will write onboarding note and next run plan. :memo:
